shifts.summary: The shift was overall moderate in difficulty. Candidates attempted between 72 and 89 questions overall. Reasoning was generally easy to moderate, while GA varied from easy to difficult. Quant was easy to moderate but some found it tough, and English ranged from easy to moderate.

sections.name: General Intelligence & Reasoning
sections.notes: Mouse malfunction and staff unresponsive were reported. Reasoning was described as simple and top‑notch, but options looked similar and were time‑consuming. Candidates found statement‑based and blood‑relation items easy, with no clock/dice questions.

sections.name: General Awareness
sections.notes: GS questions were reported as tough and some out of syllabus. Others found GA easy with topics across polity, economics and current affairs. Statistics items appeared in some papers.

topics.topic: Buddhist art linked to Gandhara & Mathura

sections.name: Quantitative Aptitude
sections.notes: 25 math questions were set for 15 minutes, two left unanswered. Most questions were arithmetic and formula‑based, but advanced math weightage was high for some candidates. Mensuration dominated, with few trigonometry and little arithmetic.

sections.name: English Comprehension
sections.notes: English was easy but passages were long and time‑tight. Cloze tests were straightforward, while grammar and vocabulary items were present. Some candidates found English hardest due to limited vocab questions.
